description: builds new agents for Toyota's team, and the ADWs they drive
notes: The only agent whose deliverable is source code in this repository rather than a report in rol_finances, hence the output_path pointing at the agents directory it writes into. Edit is in allowed_tools because registration means three surgical edits to fail-loud files (extra_roles.py, roles.py, toyota's system prompt) where overwriting with Write would be reckless. max_turns 80 because one run reads four reference documents, writes an ADW plus six agent files, makes three edits, and runs a five-command verification gate. Will be renamed Scissari.
